text.en:
The name of the municipality of Malabon, Province of Cavite, is hereby changed to General
Trias, and after the approval of this Act, all territory comprised in the jurisdiction of said municipality of
Malabon shall be called General Trias, as herein provided.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 24, 1920.
